description: Curated girlfriend/wife gift catalogs for building shopping lists and wishlists: 245 amazon.se /dp ASINs (default) and a separate US catalog of ASINs verified live on amazon.com (pass marketplace=amazon.com → https://www.amazon.com/dp/ASIN buy links, tagged with the server-configured amazon.com tag when set). On other marketplaces catalogMode is search-ideas. ALWAYS pass marketplace + locale. OpenAPI: getCatalog.

locale.description: User locale, e.g. en, sv, de, fr, es

marketplace.description: Amazon storefront domain or id for the end user, e.g. amazon.com, amazon.se, us, se, de. REQUIRED — curated catalogs with real /dp ASINs on amazon.se (Sweden, default) and amazon.com (United States: marketplace=amazon.com → https://www.amazon.com/dp/ASIN links); other marketplaces get romantic search deep-links.

name: get_catalog
title: Curated gift catalog
